adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts`, `calendarReference` was changed from a single reference to an array via `.filter(...)` and the update logic now loops over all `_calendar` references. However, in the merge/reschedule path (`if (newBookingId) { ... }`), it still uses `booking.references.find((reference) => reference.type.includes("_calendar"))` to select `oldCalendarEvent`, meaning only the first old calendar reference is deleted. If multiple per-host calendar references exist (consistent with the new multi-destination/per-host logic added in this diff), the remaining old references' events would not be deleted and can remain orphaned.
